item.title: Faced with court backlog, lawmakers aim to add more lawyers, judges statewide
item.description: The proposal to add more than 100 court positions is awaiting approval by Wisconsin's Republican-controlled Senate, after clearing the GOP-led Assembly in February. The post Faced with court backlog, lawmakers aim to add more lawyers, judges statewide appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Evers calls for special session to ban partisan gerrymandering
item.description: Gov. Tony Evers has ordered Wisconsin lawmakers to return for a special session next month to consider a constitutional amendment aimed at ending partisan gerrymandering in state legislative districts. The post Evers calls for special session to ban partisan gerrymandering appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin could expand newly-implemented school cell phone ban
item.description: A new Republican proposal would require schools to adopt a “bell-to-bell” ban on cell phones by July 1, 2027. The post Wisconsin could expand newly-implemented school cell phone ban appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Cold-smoking sausage tradition continues in Marathon County
item.description: Cold-smoking is a meat preservation method used by many Northern cultures around the world for thousands of years. The post Cold-smoking sausage tradition continues in Marathon County appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Maple syrup has a special place in rural Wisconsin communities
item.description: From breakfast oatmeal to brandy old fashioneds at night, maple syrup plays a starring role. Several communities around the state — including Phelps — celebrate the ingredient with festivals. The post Maple syrup has a special place in rural Wisconsin communities appeared first on WPR.

item.title: GOP lawmakers approve reduced funding for Department of Public Instruction
item.description: Republican state lawmakers partially approved a funding request from the Wisconsin Department of Instruction Tuesday, a move that comes about a month after the agency was scrutinized for spending $368,885 on a meeting at a Wisconsin Dells resort. The post GOP lawmakers approve reduced funding for Department of Public Instruction appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Opponents blast CAFO’s plan to expand in Pierce County in contested case hearing
item.description: Opponents of a large livestock farm’s plans to expand in Pierce County blasted the state’s approval during a contested case hearing Tuesday, voicing concerns the expansion would raise risks of groundwater contamination. The post Opponents blast CAFO’s plan to expand in Pierce County in contested case hearing appeared first on WPR.

item.title: US Rep. Mark Pocan: More questions for White House than answers on war in Iran
item.description: U.S. Rep. Mark Pocan of Wisconsin said he isn’t satisfied with the justification the White House gave during a classified briefing on Tuesday for joining Israel in attacking Iran. The post US Rep. Mark Pocan: More questions for White House than answers on war in Iran appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Bankrupt processor convicted of animal mistreatment for abandoning 2M chickens
item.description: Pure Prairie Poultry was found guilty due to a no contest plea on Tuesday after failing to send a representative to the Buffalo County court. The post Bankrupt processor convicted of animal mistreatment for abandoning 2M chickens appeared first on WPR.
